verdict: Organic signals are fading; overdue milestones are the priority to close.
narrative: Across all three entities — Forte Metals, Advance Grinding, and O'Hare Precision — the last 28 days produced zero paid spend and zero paid leads, meaning every signal this period came from Google Business Profile and organic search alone. Combined GBP actions totaled 329 across the three brands, but all three profiles saw sharp drops in the final days of the window, with week-over-week GBP declines of 84%, 92%, and 86% respectively. That deceleration is compounded by a set of CRM, Web/SEO, and outreach milestones that remain open and are gating the next phase of work. We are actively resolving those blockers — stub reconciliation, the Web/SEO root-cause fix, and the contact pulls needed to launch outreach sequences — so that downstream pipeline activity can begin. Once those items close, outreach sequences launch and site reindexing begins, which is where the next meaningful lead volume will come from.

highlights.phrase: total Google Business Profile actions across all three brands this period (calls, direction requests, and website clicks)
paid leads or ad spend recorded across any channel or entity in the last 28 days
overdue project milestones — spanning CRM, web, and outreach — now being actively closed

watch_item.issue: GBP engagement dropped sharply in the final days across all three brands, and key milestones gating outreach and SEO recovery remain open past their due dates.
watch_item.fix: The stub reconciliation, Web/SEO root-cause submission, and contact pulls are being resolved this period so outreach sequences and site reindexing can begin on schedule by end of September.
